items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] They saw me, they had all kind of trains. Gromwell, Rube, Rickman,

ctx.x: I was waiting out there at night. I wouldn't bother me in the box cars. You know, with bananas and things. So you didn't go to work then? Oh no, the train turned around that morning. Everybody. There's all me, there's all kinds of train. How about Spanish-American water? Do you remember that? So you didn't go to work then? On all the trains right around that morning. Everybody.
They saw me, they had all kind of trains. Gromwell, Rube, Rickman,

anywhere it was a diesel, you see. How about Spanish-American water, do you remember that? You remember that? Oh, by the way, did any of the bands in Linkin Park or Johnson Park, did they play any hymns? Hymns? No, I didn't. No, they didn't play any hymns like, what's called that? Saints Go Marginal. Oh yeah, they did that.
